instruction: At my job, we manage the tasks on todoist. But I am changing job soon, so for each task that is assigned to me and is incomplete yet, I have asked who can take it from me. See the discussion in comments and reassign based on it. Then, leave a comment there, "Thank you <person_first_name>!". Here <person_first_name> is the first name of the person who is reassigned the task. If no one has agreed to take the task, leave it as is.
notes: Representative instance: one project, three incomplete tasks assigned to the supervisor; two have a colleague agreeing in the comments (reassign + thank-you comment), one has no volunteer and is left untouched. Static init facts volunteer-for / person-email / thank-you-text stand for hidden world information that is only usable after show_task_comments (gated by comments-checked); actual counts and names are discovered at runtime. show_tasks is called with assignee_email = supervisor email and is_completed = false so only relevant tasks are returned. assign_or_unassign_task is only applicable for tasks with a volunteer, so no-volunteer tasks cannot be modified; each task is reassigned/commented at most once. supervisor.complete_task takes the handled task records as non-API parameters so its precondition covers every goal condition; it is the last action.

plan: (supervisor-complete-task task-3 task-4 task-5 colleague-3 colleague-4 thank-you-colleague-3 thank-you-colleague-4)
